ielts.note: Most bachelor programmes need German at level C1 when you enrol. Some programmes where English is essential (for example computer science) also require English at B2 (IELTS 6.0 or higher).

requirement.text: International applicants need a recognised university entrance qualification with an overall grade equivalent to German 2.5 or better; weaker grades can be compensated with a TestAS aptitude test result.
